statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. Call an axis-aligned rectangle valid for points if its four corners are four distinct input points and no other input point lies inside or on the border of the rectangle; its area is width*height. If at least one valid rectangle exists, then r equals the maximum area among all valid rectangles; in particular r != -1 and there is a valid rectangle of area r. If no valid rectangle exists, then r = -1.
preconditions: points is a slice with 1 <= len(points) <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r (i.e., it does not fail).
preconditions: points is a slice with 1 <= len(points) <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, either r = -1 or 1 <= r <= 10000.
preconditions: points is a slice with 1 <= len(points) <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = -1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, there exist four input points that are the corners of an axis-aligned rectangle of positive width and height, no other input point lies inside or on the border of that rectangle, and width*height = r.
preconditions: points is a slice with 1 <= len(points) <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, for every axis-aligned rectangle whose four corners are input points, which has positive width and height, and which contains no other input point inside or on its border, the area of that rectangle is at most r.
preconditions: points is a slice with 1 <= len(points) <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = -1, there is no axis-aligned rectangle with positive width and height whose four corners are input points and which contains no other input point inside or on its border.
preconditions: points is a slice with 1 <= len(points) <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r != -1 if and only if the four input points are exactly the four corners of some axis-aligned rectangle with positive width and height; when this holds, r = (max_x - min_x)*(max_y - min_y), where max_x and min_x are the maximum and minimum x-coordinates among the four input points and max_y and min_y are the maximum and minimum y-coordinates among the four input points; when this does not hold, r = -1.
preconditions: points is a slice with len(points) = 4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns r on points and r' on points', r = r'.
preconditions: points and points' each satisfy: 1 <= len <= 10; every entry has length 2 with coordinates in [0,100]; all coordinate pairs are distinct. Also, points' is a permutation of points (the same multiset of coordinate pairs).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, r <= (max_x - min_x)*(max_y - min_y), where max_x and min_x are the maximum and minimum x-coordinates among all input points, and max_y and min_y are the maximum and minimum y-coordinates among all input points.
preconditions: points is a slice with 1 <= len(points) <= 10; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), points[i] has length 2 and 0 <= points[i][0] <= 100 and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 100; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), points[i] != points[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, there exist distinct indices i,j,k,l with 0 <= i,j,k,l < len(points) and integers a < c and b < d such that points[i][0] = a, points[i][1] = b, points[j][0] = a, points[j][1] = d, points[k][0] = c, points[k][1] = b, points[l][0] = c, points[l][1] = d, and r = (c-a)*(d-b).
